headline: 3 core contracts discovered: PSOL token, Phantom stake pool, and Solana SPL stake pool program
short_headline: 3 contracts across Solana: PSOL token + pool + SPL program

findings.text: Solana blockchain explorer searches and off-chain sources identified PSOL token (pSo1f9nQXWgXibFtKf7NWYxb5enAM4qfP6UJSiXRQfL) and Phantom stake pool (pSPcvR8GmG9aKDUbn9nbKYjkxt9hxMS7kF1qqKJaPqJ)
No canonical deployed contracts documentation page found on Phantom website; addresses sourced from help docs, blog posts, and block explorer references
No audit links recorded for Phantom SOL itself; underlying Solana SPL stake pool program has 9 audits from Quantstamp, Neodyme (4x), OtterSec, Halborn (2x) documented at solana-program.com
No GitHub repository pinned in protocol context; Phantom is primarily a wallet/UI product. Stake pool leverages Solana Labs open-source stake-pool program
Single-chain protocol (Solana only); D1-D4 fully applied to Solana mainnet-beta
No factory pattern detected; single PSOL token and single stake pool account identified. No enumeration of child contracts required
Two role classifications applied: PSOL token (token), Phantom stake pool (pool). Admin/authority addresses not yet determined from discovered contracts
All addresses traceable to fetched sources: Solflare price page, Solana Compass, Phantom blog, and Solana program documentation

rationale.verdict: Discovery identified 3 key on-chain accounts: the PSOL token contract, Phantom's stake pool account, and the underlying Solana SPL stake pool program. PSOL token address confirmed via multiple sources (Solflare, Solana Compass, Phantom blog). No admin/upgrade authorities or governance structures directly documented; PSOL relies on the audited Solana stake pool program with no custom smart contracts deployed by Phantom beyond wallet integration. Stake pool operations handled by Solana's standard SPL stake pool program.

protocol_metadata.about: Phantom Staked SOL (PSOL) is a liquid staking token on Solana launched by Phantom in May 2025. Users stake SOL to receive PSOL, a yield-bearing token that accrues staking rewards, MEV tips, and priority fees. PSOL is self-custodial and built on the audited Solana stake pool program (9 security audits). No custom smart contracts; leverages Solana Labs' standard SPL stake pool infrastructure.
